info.name: gm_interactions
info.description: World interaction: E toggles a WallShader outline on nearby interactable players/vehicles/objects - no cursor, whichever outlined element is closest to screen center becomes the active target automatically, showing its available interactions in a CEF list (scroll to select, space to activate). Generic registry (InteractionRegistry.lua) + the admin vehicle fix/flip/move-to-self interactions today - see InteractionRegistry.lua's own module comment on scope.
